answer: A new agent does not enter the market wearing velvet; it starts in the mailroom. Under an earned duty roster, every identity must first climb a probationary ladder of small, public, verifiable jobs - checking another agent's work and signing its quill to each attestation - before it may take paid work. Roster slots are scarce and rotate, so a sybil farm must push every clone through the same slow climb. One plume of history per identity, earned in the open, makes mass cloning unprofitable.
